title: SvgMask
responsibility: Renders the native mask element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: SvgMask.attributes
inputs.description: Native mask attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: SvgMask.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native mask element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: SvgMask
outputs.description: The actual native mask element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
